import re
import sys

with open(sys.argv[1], 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    xml = f.read()

# Find paragraphs with heading styles
for m in re.finditer(r'<w:p\b.*?</w:p>', xml, re.DOTALL):
    para = m.group(0)
    style = re.search(r'<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]+)"', para)
    if style and 'Heading' in style.group(1):
        texts = re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>', para)
        print(f"STYLE={style.group(1)} TEXT={''.join(texts)}")

import sys
from pathlib import Path

SKILL_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / ".codex/skills/docx"
sys.path.insert(0, str(SKILL_ROOT))

from scripts.document import Document

HEADLINES = [
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
]

doc = Document("unpacked", rsid="3F2A2632")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]

for text in HEADLINES:
    para = editor.get_node(tag="w:p", contains=text)
    runs = para.getElementsByTagName("w:r")
    for run in runs:
        rpr_list = run.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
        if rpr_list:
            rpr = rpr_list[0]
        else:
            rpr = editor.dom.createElement("w:rPr")
            run.insertBefore(rpr, run.firstChild)
        u_list = rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u")
        if u_list:
            u_list[0].setAttribute("w:val", "single")
        else:
            u = editor.dom.createElement("w:u")
            u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
            # Insert after w:szCs / w:sz to keep schema element order
            sz_cs = rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:szCs")
            sz = rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:sz")
            anchor = sz_cs[0] if sz_cs else (sz[0] if sz else None)
            if anchor is not None:
                anchor.parentNode.insertBefore(u, anchor.nextSibling)
            else:
                rpr.insertBefore(u, rpr.firstChild)
    print(f"Underlined: {text}")

doc.save()
print("Saved successfully.")
